sc_courts_circuit_civil.blocker: Disclaimer page confirmed live 2026-08-22 states verbatim: "Access to the South Carolina Judicial Department Public Index web sites by a site data scraper or any similar software intended to discover and extract data from a website through automated, repetitive querying for the purpose of collecting such data is expressly prohibited." This is a stated ToS prohibition on a government judicial site, not a technical obstacle — no automated scraper will be built against this source. Columbia Star's "Public Notices" (lis pendens) and "Master's Sales" (foreclosure) sections substitute for the case-level signals this source would have provided.

master_in_equity_foreclosure_sales.official_entity: Richland County Master-in-Equity Court — Joseph M. Strickland, Master-in-Equity
master_in_equity_foreclosure_sales.portal_type: Monthly judicial foreclosure sale notice page. SC is a judicial foreclosure state — all foreclosures are court-ordered and conducted by the Master-in-Equity.
master_in_equity_foreclosure_sales.verification_note: richlandcountysc.gov is the official county domain. Foreclosure-Sales page confirmed. Sales also published in the Columbia Star newspaper as required legal notices. Confirmed sale format: case number, property address, TMS/PIN number, plaintiff, defendant, sale time/location. Sales conducted at 2500 Decker Blvd, Columbia SC 29206, Courtroom #1, typically first Monday of month at 12:00 Noon.
open_questions: Does the richlandcountysc.gov/Foreclosure-Sales page publish the full sale list as HTML or does it link to a PDF? Operator should confirm format before building scraper.
Is the Columbia Star (thecolumbiastar.com) the primary or secondary publication? Is there an official county-hosted PDF of the monthly sale list?
known_limitations: Monthly cadence only — not a daily source.
Sale list published 30+ days in advance by legal notice requirement; lead-to-sale window is narrow once published.
SC judicial foreclosure: owner has right of redemption up until sale — not all listed properties actually sell.

The entire richlandcountysc.gov domain is behind Akamai and returns a hard Access Denied (edgesuite.net block) on every request from this build environment, including the homepage — confirmed 2026-08-22 via direct requests and curl, no browser-header combination bypassed it.
master_in_equity_foreclosure_sales.blocker: Akamai WAF blocks the entire richlandcountysc.gov domain from this environment's IP — every request (even the homepage) returns HTTP 403 'Access Denied' from errors.edgesuite.net. Columbia Star's "Master's Sales" section substitutes for this signal (already live, weekly).

register_of_deeds_sms.portal_type: Richland County SMS (Subscription Management System) — online deed and document recording index. Custom-built county portal. Covers records from 2/19/1998 onward with document images; index-only for pre-1998 records.
register_of_deeds_sms.verification_note: Portal confirmed at www7.richlandcountysc.gov/SMS_External/ — the Richland County SMS (Subscription Management System), which hands off to a second app 'RODPublicViewer' for the actual document search. Operator registered a paid 'Register Of Deeds / Unlimited-Full Access' subscription (08/21/2026-09/22/2026), confirmed live in the account's 'Current Subscriptions' list 2026-08-22. Login (including the login CAPTCHA — its 'random' seed is embedded in plaintext elsewhere on the page, no OCR needed) and navigation to the search form (QueryPanel.aspx) are confirmed working — see scrapers/richland_register_of_deeds.py. Registry has 254 document types; no standalone Lis Pendens type exists here (SC lis pendens is a Clerk of Court filing, already covered by Columbia Star's Public Notices) — highest-value unique adds would be mechanics liens, federal/state tax liens, and foreclosure-completion deeds.
register_of_deeds_sms.blocker: Login and search-form navigation work, but every search submission (tested via raw HTTP and a real Playwright-driven Chromium browser, across multiple doc types / date ranges / name-only queries) returns a server-side '.NET FormatException: Input string was not in a correct format.' All submitted field values are confirmed correctly received and echoed back by the server, so the exception is not in field parsing — it happens deeper in the search-execution path. The operator confirmed getting real results from one manual search in a real browser, so the portal is not fundamentally broken; something about the automated flow (or session state — ~15 automated logins were performed while debugging this, which may itself have degraded session state) differs from a clean manual search. Paused per operator instruction 2026-08-22 pending a clean repro.
open_questions: What exact request does a clean, single manual search send (doc type, date range, name fields) — ideally captured via browser DevTools Network tab — that the automated flow's structurally-identical request does not?
Does repeated automated login (many logins in a short window while debugging) degrade or corrupt server-side session state for this account?
Once search works: what does the results list response actually look like? Never observed populated in testing — client JS references a 'divResults' div that was never seen non-empty.
known_limitations: 254 document types in the registry; no bulk 'all types' search confirmed to work yet — MVP scope should target mechanics liens, federal/state tax liens, and foreclosure-completion deeds (Foreclosure - Deed, Foreclosure - Mortgage, Master's Deed-Foreclosure) once search is unblocked.
Records before 2/19/1998 have index only — no document images online.
Search execution currently broken for automated (and possibly all) use — see blocker.
register_of_deeds_sms.paused_reason: Search submission errors server-side for reasons not yet isolated; operator asked to pause investigation 2026-08-22 rather than continue debugging live.

delinquent_tax_sale.portal_type: Annual delinquent tax sale page with GIS parcel viewer and PDF legal notice publication. Includes forfeited land list.
delinquent_tax_sale.verification_note: richlandcountysc.gov is the official county domain. Tax Sale page confirmed. GIS Tax Sale Parcel Viewer confirmed at richlandmaps.com/apps/delinquent/ (official county GIS domain). Legal notice PDF published annually at richlandcountysc.gov/portals/0/Departments/Treasurer/TaxSale/LegalNotice.pdf. Forfeited Land Available page also confirmed. Tax sale is annual (typically November/December in SC). 1-year+1-day redemption period per SC Code Ann. § 12-51-90.
open_questions: Is the delinquent tax list available as a downloadable CSV or only as a PDF legal notice and GIS viewer? Operator should check the tax sale page directly for download options.
When is the 2026 delinquent tax sale scheduled? (Typically November/December in SC.)
known_limitations: Annual cadence — not a continuous daily feed. Delinquent list grows throughout the year but official sale notice is annual.
SC 1-year+1-day redemption period means delinquent properties remain redeemable for over a year after sale — not immediate distress.
GIS viewer may not support bulk export.

Master-in-Equity monthly foreclosure sale list also confirmed. Register of Deeds (clerk_recordings, highest-value source for lis pendens and deed recordings) is BLOCKED pending operator account creation at www7.richlandcountysc.gov/SMS_External/. Code enforcement: NOT_FOUND as public list. Verdict is READY_WITH_BLOCKERS rather than READY_TO_BUILD because RoD blocker should be resolved before Build Mode to avoid building scrapers around an incomplete source map.
